subject.title: fix(llm): summarize ephemeral tool results to preserve prefix cache

question: Which tool-result visibility policy should this PR implement before merge: a narrow heartbeat/status-only cache placeholder, broader suppression of ordinary tool outputs, or a different mechanism such as isolated heartbeat sessions or tool-result middleware?
rationale: The implementation choice changes model-visible session state and can break normal tool reasoning, so code inspection alone should not decide the permanent product policy.

options.title: Narrow and rebase first
options.body: Limit placeholders to maintainer-approved low-value heartbeat/status results, port the change to `packages/ai`, and require live DeepSeek proof.

options.title: Pause for a different mechanism
options.body: Use isolated heartbeat sessions, context pruning, or plugin/tool middleware instead of provider-wide result hiding.

options.title: Accept broad suppression intentionally
options.body: Maintainers may choose to hide broader tool classes, but this should be an explicit compatibility-breaking policy decision with tests and docs.

recommendation.title: Narrow and rebase first
recommendation.body: Limit placeholders to maintainer-approved low-value heartbeat/status results, port the change to `packages/ai`, and require live DeepSeek proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest routing candidate for the provider-cache policy decision from the likely-owner set.
